entries.en: The historical case report described a benign carcinoid in the intestine.
entries.zh: 这份历史病例报告描述了肠内的一枚良性类癌肿瘤。

entries.en: The physiology class compared resting muscle tonus in several recorded observations.
entries.zh: 生理学课堂比较了几次记录观察中的静息肌张力。

entries.en: The apprentice spoke confidingly to the mentor about a difficult decision.
entries.zh: 学徒信任地向导师谈起一个艰难的决定。

entries.en: The director encouraged the comedian to ham it up during the dream sequence.
entries.zh: 导演鼓励喜剧演员在梦境段落中夸张表演。

entries.en: Please do not fiddle with the microphone cable during the interview.
entries.zh: 采访期间，请不要乱动麦克风电缆。

entries.en: The analyst used a decision table to check every combination of input conditions.
entries.zh: 分析员用判定表检查了输入条件的每种组合。

entries.en: The dog could scent out the hidden toy beneath the leaves.
entries.zh: 狗能闻出藏在树叶下面的玩具。

entries.en: The festival organizer was on the go from dawn until midnight.
entries.zh: 节庆组织者从黎明到午夜一直忙个不停。

entries.en: We can look up the train times at the information kiosk.
entries.zh: 我们可以在信息亭查询火车时刻。

entries.en: The customs history exhibit displayed a free list from an old tariff schedule.
entries.zh: 海关史展览展示了一张取自旧关税表的免税货物单。

entries.en: The estate map marks a secluded pleasance behind the mansion.
entries.zh: 庄园地图标出了宅邸后方一处幽静的游憩花园。

entries.en: The historian traced the obligations of a villein through medieval estate records.
entries.zh: 历史学者通过中世纪庄园记录追溯了一位隶农的义务。

entries.en: The collector found a tenpence beneath the lining of an old purse.
entries.zh: 收藏者在旧钱包的衬里下面找到了一枚十便士硬币。

entries.en: The library reduced her work load while she organized the exhibition.
entries.zh: 她筹办展览期间，图书馆减少了她的工作量。

entries.en: The breeder's records confirmed the colt's full blood.
entries.zh: 育种者的记录证实了这匹小公马的纯血统。

entries.en: The skiing video showed a kick turn on a narrow snowy slope.
entries.zh: 滑雪视频展示了在狭窄雪坡上进行踢腿转弯的动作。

entries.en: The passing train threatened to drown out the outdoor concert.
entries.zh: 经过的火车发出的声音可能会盖过室外音乐会的声音。

entries.en: The economics chart compared money supply with nominal output over the period.
entries.zh: 这张经济学图表比较了该时期内的货币供应量与名义产出。

entries.en: The survey compared the cost of living in three university towns.
entries.zh: 这项调查比较了三个大学城的生活费用。

entries.en: The carpenter checked that the tenon fitted neatly into the mortice.
entries.zh: 木匠检查了榫头是否能恰好嵌入榫眼。

entries.en: The molecular biology diagram showed a liposome carrying a nucleic acid sample.
entries.zh: 分子生物学示意图展示了一个携带核酸样品的脂质体。

entries.en: The biology seminar examined isomorphism in the external structures of two organisms.
entries.zh: 生物学研讨会考察了两种生物外部结构的同形性。

entries.en: The mysterious visitor became the talk of the town before anyone learned his name.
entries.zh: 在人们得知他的姓名前，那位神秘访客就成了全镇谈论的话题。

entries.en: The children began to chase after the kite as it crossed the field.
entries.zh: 风筝飘过田野时，孩子们开始追赶它。

entries.en: The novel follows a cave man searching for shelter before winter.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一个穴居人在冬天到来前寻找栖身之处的故事。

entries.en: The apartment house has a shared garden behind its main entrance.
entries.zh: 这栋公寓楼的主入口后面有一座共用花园。

entries.en: The runners crossed the finish line within a second of each other.
entries.zh: 几名跑者相继冲过终点线，彼此相差不到一秒。

entries.en: The old engine rattled like sin on the steep climb.
entries.zh: 那台旧发动机在爬陡坡时剧烈地震响。

entries.en: The memoir describes a crammer hired to prepare students for entrance examinations.
entries.zh: 回忆录描述了一位受雇为学生突击准备入学考试的填鸭式教学教师。

entries.en: They placed the sleeping baby in a carrycot beside the bench.
entries.zh: 他们把熟睡的婴儿放进长凳旁的轻便婴儿床。

entries.en: The vendor pushed an applecart toward the crowded market entrance.
entries.zh: 小贩推着一辆卖苹果的手推车走向拥挤的市场入口。

entries.en: The shop owner checked the current account before paying the supplier.
entries.zh: 店主在向供应商付款前查看了往来账户。

entries.en: The exhibition explores the influence of the space age on furniture design.
entries.zh: 展览探讨了航天时代对家具设计的影响。

entries.en: The old novel describes a mother pausing to give suck to her infant.
entries.zh: 这部旧小说描写了一位母亲停下来给婴儿哺乳。

entries.en: The film star arrived quietly through the theater's side entrance.
entries.zh: 电影明星从剧院侧门悄悄到场。

entries.en: The biology model displayed the muscle system beneath a removable outer layer.
entries.zh: 生物模型在可拆卸外层下展示了肌肉系统。

entries.en: The legal history lecture examined a bill of attainder passed during the rebellion.
entries.zh: 法律史讲座考察了一项在叛乱期间通过的剥夺公权法案。

entries.en: The historian described how a diplomatic confrontation developed into a hot war.
entries.zh: 历史学者描述了一场外交对峙如何发展为热战。

entries.en: The acoustics worksheet expressed the panel's absorption in sabins.
entries.zh: 声学练习纸以赛宾表示这块板的吸声量。

entries.en: A ferny bank shaded the narrow stream behind the house.
entries.zh: 房后的狭窄溪流旁，长满蕨类植物的河岸投下了阴影。

entries.en: The philosopher questioned the categorial distinction between objects and events.
entries.zh: 哲学家质疑了物体与事件之间的范畴区分。

entries.en: The choir's archive contains several centuries of church music.
entries.zh: 唱诗班的档案收藏了跨越数个世纪的教会音乐。

entries.en: The editor checked each entry word against the alphabetical index.
entries.zh: 编辑将每个词条的开头词与字母索引进行核对。

entries.en: The hardware store allowed regular customers to use a charge account.
entries.zh: 五金店允许老顾客使用赊账账户。

entries.en: We watched the cat sneak out through a gap beside the gate.
entries.zh: 我们看着猫从大门旁的一道缝隙偷偷溜了出去。

entries.en: The historical novel portrays a party boss who controls local appointments.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说描绘了一位控制地方任命的政党首脑。

entries.en: The archive catalog records the magnetic tape's density in bpi.
entries.zh: 档案目录以比特每英寸记录这盘磁带的存储密度。

entries.en: The memoir describes daily life in a barrio outside the capital.
entries.zh: 回忆录描述了首都外围一个城区的日常生活。

entries.en: The cathedral archive preserved letters written by a nineteenth-century prebendary.
entries.zh: 大教堂档案馆保存了一位十九世纪受俸牧师的书信。

entries.en: The lamp must plug into the socket beside the desk.
entries.zh: 这盏灯的插头必须插进书桌旁的插座。

entries.en: He swallowed the invented story hook line and sinker.
entries.zh: 他完全相信了那个编造的故事。

entries.en: The material's label warned that high temperature could distort its shape.
entries.zh: 材料标签警示，高温可能使其变形。

entries.en: The stage mechanism could thrust out a platform above the audience.
entries.zh: 舞台机械装置能够在观众上方推出一个平台。

entries.en: The guitarist found a spare plectrum inside the instrument case.
entries.zh: 吉他手在琴盒里找到了一片备用琴拨。

entries.en: The photograph shows a cumulation of broken tiles beside the demolished wall.
entries.zh: 照片展示了被拆墙旁堆积的一堆碎瓦。

entries.en: The technician checked the warning lights on the control board.
entries.zh: 技术人员检查了控制盘上的警示灯。

entries.en: We needed an hour to chill out after the tense rehearsal.
entries.zh: 紧张的排练结束后，我们需要一个小时放松一下。

entries.en: A power failure interrupted the film halfway through its final scene.
entries.zh: 电影最后一个场景播放到一半时，一次停电打断了播放。

entries.en: The walker pulled a cagoule from the backpack as rain began.
entries.zh: 开始下雨时，徒步者从背包里拿出了一件带帽薄防风衣。

entries.en: The angelus sounded across the square as the market stalls closed.
entries.zh: 市场摊位收摊时，奉告祈祷的钟声响彻广场。

entries.en: The skeletal model highlighted the tarsus in a contrasting color.
entries.zh: 骨骼模型用对比色突出了跗骨部分。

entries.en: Several committee members decided to plunk for the smaller design.
entries.zh: 几位委员会成员决定支持较小的设计方案。

entries.en: In the sitcom, the manager begins to chew out the careless delivery driver.
entries.zh: 在这部情景喜剧中，经理开始严厉责备粗心的送货司机。

entries.en: The traveler noticed the cancellation condition in the small print.
entries.zh: 旅客在附属细则中注意到了取消条件。

entries.en: You can scratch out the old address and write the new one below.
entries.zh: 你可以划掉旧地址，在下面写上新地址。

entries.en: The football match will kick off at noon in the main stadium.
entries.zh: 足球比赛将在正午于主体育场中线开球。

entries.en: The financial officer checked each payment against the approved budget.
entries.zh: 财务主任将每笔付款与已批准的预算逐一核对。

entries.en: The department expected to underspend its travel budget after several conferences moved online.
entries.zh: 几场会议转为线上举行后，部门预计其差旅预算会有结余。

entries.en: The precentor signaled the choir to begin the next verse.
entries.zh: 领唱人示意唱诗班开始下一节诗句。

entries.en: The experiment compared the growth rate of seedlings under two light conditions.
entries.zh: 实验比较了幼苗在两种光照条件下的生长速率。

entries.en: The fictional detective questioned why a dead person appeared on the passenger list.
entries.zh: 虚构的侦探质疑，为什么一个死人会出现在乘客名单上。

entries.en: The old railway ticket allowed travel in third class only.
entries.zh: 这张旧火车票只允许乘坐三等车厢。

entries.meaningZh: 筹划不周难以成功的计划
entries.en: The expansion plan became a house of cards when its main investor withdrew.
entries.zh: 主要投资者退出后，扩张计划便成了摇摇欲坠的空中楼阁。

entries.en: The biography describes the writer's appointment as a life peer.
entries.zh: 这部传记描述了该作家被授予终身贵族爵位的经过。

entries.en: His half sister, who shared his father, joined him on the trip.
entries.zh: 他同父异母的姐妹与他一同参加了这次旅行。

entries.en: The medical historian found morphia listed in an old dispensary ledger.
entries.zh: 医学史学者在一本旧药房账簿中发现了吗啡的记录。

entries.en: The costume designer selected a wool raglan for the winter scene.
entries.zh: 服装设计师为冬季场景挑选了一件羊毛套袖大衣。

entries.en: The museum's old climbing harness still had its original life belt.
entries.zh: 博物馆收藏的旧攀登吊带仍保留着原装安全带。

entries.en: The graduate school organized a workshop on presenting research to general audiences.
entries.zh: 研究生院举办了一个向普通听众介绍研究的工作坊。

entries.en: The exercise treated lost study time as an opportunity cost of overtime work.
entries.zh: 这道练习把损失的学习时间视为加班工作的机会成本。

entries.en: The planned closure became public knowledge after the newspaper published the memo.
entries.zh: 报纸刊登备忘录后，拟议关闭的消息便众所周知了。

entries.en: The accounting students reconciled the owner's capital account at the year end.
entries.zh: 会计专业的学生在年末核对了业主的资本账户。

entries.en: The union distributed strike pay from a fund built through members' contributions.
entries.zh: 工会从会员缴款积累的基金中发放罢工津贴。

entries.en: Unexpected visitors would often burst in on the family's evening meal.
entries.zh: 不速之客常会突然闯入，打断这一家人吃晚饭。

entries.en: The salvage team hoped to refloat the stranded boat at high tide.
entries.zh: 打捞队希望在涨潮时使搁浅的船重新浮起。

entries.en: The veterinary study tracked oestrus in the herd over several months.
entries.zh: 这项兽医研究连续数月追踪了畜群的发情情况。

entries.en: The seminar compared a deconstructionist reading with a historical interpretation of the poem.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了对这首诗的解构主义解读与历史性阐释。

entries.en: The classroom model showed unsold stock when the price floor exceeded equilibrium.
entries.zh: 课堂模型显示，当价格下限高于均衡价格时会出现未售出的存货。

entries.en: The speaker made eye contact with people at the back of the room.
entries.zh: 发言者与房间后排的人进行了目光接触。

entries.en: The bus company added a late service after the concert.
entries.zh: 公共汽车公司在音乐会结束后增开了一班晚间车。

entries.en: The linguist compared the tone system of two neighboring dialects.
entries.zh: 语言学家比较了两种相邻方言的声调系统。

entries.meaningZh: 了不起的事（常用于反语）
entries.en: He called winning a small office raffle a big deal.
entries.zh: 他把赢得办公室一次小抽奖说成了不得了的大事。

entries.en: The student identified a white cell in the stained blood image.
entries.zh: 学生在染色血液图像中辨认出了一个白细胞。

entries.en: The museum exhibit traced the use of nuclear power in electricity generation.
entries.zh: 博物馆展览追溯了核动力在发电中的应用。

entries.en: The cataloguer assigned subject headings to the newly donated books.
entries.zh: 编目员为新捐赠的图书分配了主题标目。

entries.en: The archive preserved cantonal records alongside documents from the central government.
entries.zh: 档案馆将州级记录与中央政府文件一同保存。

entries.en: The mock agreement stated that the buyer's rights were assignable.
entries.zh: 这份模拟协议注明，买方的权利可以转让。

entries.en: We pulled into a rest stop beyond the mountain tunnel.
entries.zh: 我们驶入了山间隧道另一边的休息站。

entries.en: The historian compared population control programs described in two archival reports.
entries.zh: 历史学者比较了两份档案报告中描述的人口控制计划。

entries.en: The fictional shopkeeper discovered that the customer had paid with a bad check.
entries.zh: 虚构的店主发现，顾客用一张空头支票付了款。

entries.en: The passengers started a card game while waiting for the storm to pass.
entries.zh: 乘客们在等待暴风雨过去时玩起了纸牌游戏。

entries.en: To all intents and purposes, the empty station had already closed.
entries.zh: 实际上，这座空荡荡的车站已经关闭了。

entries.en: The bird vanished into the trees in the blink of an eye.
entries.zh: 鸟儿一眨眼就消失在树林中。

entries.en: The computer programme sorted the photographs by their recorded dates.
entries.zh: 计算机程序按记录日期对照片进行了排序。

entries.en: The diagram showed a large vacuole occupying much of the plant cell.
entries.zh: 示意图显示，一个大液泡占据了植物细胞的很大一部分。

entries.en: The exhibition label described the juice as pasteurised before bottling.
entries.zh: 展品标签说明，这些果汁在装瓶前经过巴氏消毒。

entries.en: The political history seminar examined syndicalism in early labor newspapers.
entries.zh: 政治史研讨会考察了早期劳工报纸中的工团主义。

entries.en: The tenants threatened to make a stink about the broken lift.
entries.zh: 房客们扬言要为坏掉的电梯大闹一场。

entries.en: The jazz club charged a cover charge in addition to the price of drinks.
entries.zh: 这家爵士乐俱乐部除酒水费用外还收取入场服务费。

entries.en: The opening march is written in common time.
entries.zh: 开场的进行曲采用四分之四拍。

entries.en: The engineering model exposed the gears inside the power train.
entries.zh: 工程模型展示了传动系内部的齿轮。

entries.en: The sort program arranged the records by surname and then by date.
entries.zh: 分类程序先按姓氏、再按日期排列记录。

entries.en: The new proposal will build upon the findings of the earlier survey.
entries.zh: 新提案将建立在先前调查结果的基础上。

entries.en: The exposed hinge was the weak point in the storage box's design.
entries.zh: 裸露的铰链是储物箱设计中的弱点。

entries.meaningZh: 拒不参加国教礼拜的天主教徒
entries.en: The historian traced a Tudor Catholic recusant's life through English parish records.
entries.zh: 历史学者通过英格兰教区记录追溯了一位都铎时期拒不参加国教礼拜的天主教徒的生平。

entries.en: The travel kit included several small haircare products.
entries.zh: 旅行套装里有几件小型护发用品。

entries.en: The laboratory team used the column to fractionate the liquid mixture.
entries.zh: 实验室团队用这根柱子对液体混合物进行分馏。

entries.en: The narrator decides to cast off the possessions that remind him of his former life.
entries.zh: 叙述者决定丢弃那些让他想起过去生活的物品。

entries.en: The college invited former students to its annual guest night.
entries.zh: 学院邀请往届学生参加一年一度的宾客之夜。

entries.en: The museum consulted members of the ethnic group before displaying the ceremonial objects.
entries.zh: 博物馆在展出礼仪用品前征询了该族群成员的意见。

entries.en: The painter mixed a little white oil colour into the blue.
entries.zh: 画家在蓝色中混入了少量白色油画颜料。

entries.en: The directory listed the area code beside each town's name.
entries.zh: 名录在每个城镇名称旁列出了电话区号。

entries.en: The chemist compared the carbonyl bands in two infrared spectra.
entries.zh: 化学家比较了两张红外光谱中的羰基谱带。

entries.en: The expedition collected sediment samples from an abyssal plain.
entries.zh: 考察队从一处深海平原采集了沉积物样品。

entries.en: A recording of plainsong played softly in the cathedral exhibition.
entries.zh: 大教堂的展览中轻轻播放着素歌录音。

entries.en: The actor had to spit out the accusation before turning away.
entries.zh: 演员必须愤怒地说出指控，然后转过身去。

entries.meaningZh: 不受政府控制的出版物
entries.en: The debate examined the role of a free press in exposing public misconduct.
entries.zh: 辩论考察了不受政府控制的新闻界在揭露公共不当行为中的作用。

entries.en: The organizers will parcel out the donated books among several village libraries.
entries.zh: 组织者将把捐赠图书分发给几家乡村图书馆。

entries.en: The teacher wrote a brief comment at the bottom of the report card.
entries.zh: 老师在成绩单底部写了一条简短评语。

entries.en: The sports archive contained footage of an athlete performing a military press.
entries.zh: 体育档案中有一段运动员进行硬推动作的影像。

entries.en: The committee met again to hammer out a workable schedule.
entries.zh: 委员会再次开会，商定了一份可行的日程。

entries.en: The flexible sculpture can change shape when visitors turn the handle.
entries.zh: 参观者转动把手时，这件柔性雕塑能够改变形状。

entries.en: The lexicography course included an exercise on selecting useful example sentences.
entries.zh: 辞典编纂课程包括一道挑选实用例句的练习。

entries.en: In the historical novel, the convicted raper is escorted from the courtroom.
entries.zh: 在这部历史小说中，被判有罪的强奸犯被押出法庭。

entries.en: The exhibit identified the moneyer whose mark appeared on the silver coin.
entries.zh: 展览介绍了那枚银币上铸记所属的铸币人。

entries.en: The children organized a ball game on the empty field.
entries.zh: 孩子们在空地上组织了一场球类比赛。

entries.en: The early bird found a seat beside the auctioneer's desk.
entries.zh: 那位早到的人在拍卖师桌旁找到了一个座位。

entries.en: We tried to see the bright side of the unexpected delay.
entries.zh: 我们努力看到这次意外延误令人欣慰的一面。

entries.en: The mobile library visits a different rural area each week.
entries.zh: 流动图书馆每周前往一个不同的农村地区。

entries.en: In the thriller, the journalist discovers his name on a hit list.
entries.zh: 在这部惊悚片中，记者发现自己的名字出现在暗杀名单上。

entries.en: The choir answered the soloist with a short antiphon.
entries.zh: 唱诗班用一段简短的唱和回应独唱者。

entries.en: The memoir follows a ranker who later commanded his former regiment.
entries.zh: 回忆录讲述了一位出身行伍的军官后来指挥自己原先所在团的经历。

entries.en: The classroom case asked whether the bailee had returned the stored painting.
entries.zh: 课堂案例询问，受托人是否归还了寄存的画作。

entries.en: The animals gathered at the last water hole before sunset.
entries.zh: 日落前，动物们聚集在最后一处水坑旁。

entries.en: The route planner must take into account the bridge's weight restriction.
entries.zh: 路线规划者必须考虑这座桥的限重规定。

entries.en: The market stall displayed a small discount for customers who pay cash.
entries.zh: 集市摊位标明，付现金的顾客可享受小额折扣。

entries.en: The historical table compared the crime rate in two districts.
entries.zh: 这张历史表格比较了两个地区的犯罪率。

entries.en: Rounding the measurement removed its final significant figure.
entries.zh: 对测量值进行舍入去掉了它最后一位有效数字。

entries.en: The editor requested a book review for the weekend supplement.
entries.zh: 编辑为周末副刊约了一篇书评。

entries.en: The expedition crossed a pathless stretch of wet moorland.
entries.zh: 考察队穿过了一片没有道路的湿润荒原。

entries.en: The museum stored the old arsenical pigment sample in a sealed display.
entries.zh: 博物馆将这份旧含砷颜料样品放在密封展柜中保存。

entries.en: The museum preserved the testimony of a former comfort woman.
entries.zh: 博物馆保存了一位前慰安妇的证词。

entries.en: We collected our tickets from the box office before lunch.
entries.zh: 我们在午饭前到售票处取了票。

entries.meaningZh: 喘气后恢复正常的呼吸
entries.en: Still walking after the climb, the hiker found a second wind and began breathing easily again.
entries.zh: 爬坡后，徒步者继续行走，呼吸又恢复了轻松平稳。

entries.en: The dashboard gauge showed a sudden drop in oil pressure.
entries.zh: 仪表盘上的表显示油压突然下降。

entries.en: The seminar compared competing visions of the welfare state after the war.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了战后对福利国家的不同构想。

entries.en: The historian described the naval deployment as a diplomatic big stick.
entries.zh: 历史学者把这次海军部署描述为外交上的大棒手段。

entries.en: The old novel portrays society's cruelty toward a supposed loose woman.
entries.zh: 这部旧小说描绘了社会对一名所谓“放荡女人”的残酷态度。

entries.en: The spelling exercise paired each homophone with a sentence showing its meaning.
entries.zh: 拼写练习为每个同音异形异义词配了一句显示其含义的句子。

entries.en: The waiter placed a jug of ice water on the table.
entries.zh: 服务员在桌上放了一壶冰水。

entries.en: The café offered a lemon water ice after the main course.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆在主菜后供应了一份柠檬冰糕。

entries.en: Every man jack of the crew helped unload the supplies.
entries.zh: 船员中的每个人都帮忙卸下了补给品。

entries.en: The detective checked whether the witnesses' separate accounts would hang together.
entries.zh: 侦探检查了证人们各自的叙述是否相互吻合。

entries.en: The historian examined the city's class structure through census records.
entries.zh: 历史学者通过人口普查记录考察了该市的阶级结构。

entries.en: She drew a face card and placed it beside the ace.
entries.zh: 她抽到一张人头牌，把它放在那张A旁边。

entries.en: The engine model stopped with its crank at dead centre.
entries.zh: 发动机模型停止时，曲柄正处在死点。

entries.en: The presenter practiced reading from the autocue without looking stiff.
entries.zh: 主持人练习对着自动提词机朗读，同时避免显得僵硬。

entries.en: A quadripartite committee brought together delegates from four neighboring towns.
entries.zh: 一个四方委员会召集了来自四个相邻城镇的代表。

entries.en: The interview became a freewheeling discussion of music, travel, and childhood memories.
entries.zh: 采访变成了一场随心所欲的讨论，谈及音乐、旅行和童年回忆。

entries.en: Please get in touch when the replacement part arrives.
entries.zh: 替换零件到货时，请与我联系。

entries.en: You can lean against the railing while we wait for the ferry.
entries.zh: 我们等渡轮时，你可以靠在栏杆上。

entries.en: The survey covered the urban area but excluded the surrounding villages.
entries.zh: 调查覆盖了城区，但不包括周围村庄。

entries.en: Several independent publishers shared a stand at the book fair.
entries.zh: 几家独立出版商在书展上共用一个展位。

entries.meaningZh: 和平与爱情的非暴力主张
entries.en: The exhibition linked flower power with posters from the late sixties.
entries.zh: 展览将和平与爱情的非暴力主张与六十年代末的海报联系起来。

entries.en: The guide word at the top helped me find the correct dictionary page.
entries.zh: 页顶的书眉词帮助我找到了正确的词典页。
